title: Grateful Dead Live at Richfield Coliseum on 1991-09-04
lineage: DAT Master>Tascam DA-30MKII>Sound Devices 702>Wavelab 5(Fades, Sample Rate Conversion)>CDWAV>FLAC
source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 from front of OTS

ai_review.summary: Superior audience recording by Keith captures a tremendous show, though it benefits from a bit of EQ work
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about Keith's tape‑pulling prowess, calling the sound superior and crystal clear, while noting that a modest amount of EQ is needed to fully appreciate the mix. The performance itself is described as a "tremendous show" despite lacking any unusual song selections.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistent 5‑star reviews highlight excellent recording quality and a strong performance, leading to a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and superior tape pull; reviewers mention the need for some EQ and ear acclimatization but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
